rules.title: A newer PremiumTV is waiting — and this is the last manual install
rules.message: You are on PremiumTV {version}. The newest release on GitHub is {newest}. Update now and PremiumTV will keep itself current from then on.
rules.surprise: Here is the surprise: the newest build updates itself. Settings → App updates checks GitHub, downloads the installer once, verifies it against the release's SHA-256 file and hands it to the normal installer — so you never download an APK or a DMG by hand again.

after_support_ends.title: Support for PremiumTV {version} ended on {support_ends}
after_support_ends.message: This build no longer receives the GitHub channel scrape updates, so its channel list and TV guide are frozen at {support_ends}. Install the newest release from GitHub to keep getting live channels, live listings and every future update in-app.
after_support_ends.surprise: The newest build still updates itself: Settings → App updates checks GitHub, verifies the installer's SHA-256 and installs it for you.
